column1: # Canonical measured outcomes — Lua-CDP CHERI column.
# reproduce.sh re-runs a fresh build+measure and FAILS on any difference.
# The three columns are the RAW per-config process outcome (as classify.py reads
# it from the exit code): exit0 = ran to completion; SIGPROT = capability fault
# cdp_async is the DERIVED security answer — "was the stale cross-domain access
# prevented at the contract point under the deployed async default?" It is `no`
# for every row: a fault (SIGPROT) never appears under async; the reads/writes
# complete (exit0), and openssl's SIGABRT is the double-free detector firing at
# the SECOND free, AFTER the stale read already completed.
# spatial is always exit0 (revocation off) — the attribution control.
# eager is always SIGPROT — synchronous revocation catches the access.
